czech: Už jsem uklidil pokoj, když přišli?
english: Had I cleaned the room before they arrived?
Had you fallen asleep before I called?

czech: Už napsal zprávu, když jsem ho potkal?
english: Had he already written the message when I met him?
Had she bought the tickets before the concert started?

czech: Obchod zavřel, než jsme tam dorazili?
english: Had the shop closed before we got there?

czech: Setkali jsme se už před večeří?

english: Had you built the fence before winter?

czech: Oni se už přestěhovali, když začala škola?
english: Had they already moved when school started?
